verdict.rationale: Deel exposes contracts, payroll, and time data via an MCP server with tools like calculateEorVersusEntityHiringCosts and listOfContracts that AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT) can invoke to generate insights, but this relies on external AI clients rather than a native in-product AI insights/suggestions feature. Missing for 10: evidence of built-in AI-generated dashboards, proactive recommendations, or analytics surfaced natively inside the Deel product UI itself, and independent corroboration of real-world use of these insights.
